tooltip.mobsshields.golden_hoglin_shield: Blocking melee attacks extends the tusks, damaging and strongly knocking back the attacker.
tooltip.mobsshields.hoglin_shield: Blocking melee attacks extends the tusks and pushes the attacker away.
tooltip.mobsshields.rotten_flesh_shield: Blocking melee attacks may summon a zombie; after a successful summon, taking damage or blocking with this shield during the effect commands all reinforcements to attack the new attacker.
tooltip.mobsshields.squid_shield: Blocking melee attacks releases ink and darkens the attacker; retreats in water.
tooltip.mobsshields.wither_rib_shield: Blocking armed melee attacks wears down the attacking item and may inflict Mining Fatigue; barehanded attacks independently roll Weakness and Mining Fatigue.
